claims: Karol G is headlining the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Karol G is the first Latina to headline the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Karol G is performing on Sunday, April 12, 2026 at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Karol G is performing on Sunday, April 19, 2026 at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Karol G is closing out the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival as a top-billed act alongside Justin Bieber and Sabrina Carpenter.
Karol G's performances at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival are streaming live on YouTube.
Karol G is launching the "Flea Market by Bichota Records" at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
The "Flea Market by Bichota Records" is a curated space for Latin American brands.
Karol G performed at Coachella in 2022 during Weekend 2.
Karol G paid tribute to Latin icons like Selena and Celia Cruz during her 2022 Coachella performance.
Karol G's 2022 Coachella performance featured special guests J Balvin and Becky G.
Karol G's 2026 Coachella performances will stream live on the official Coachella YouTube channel
